\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-47},
  title = {The serving runtime is separated by dependency groups},
  date = {2026-10-05},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Containerization, Dependency Management},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{[project] dependencies} in \texttt{pyproject.\allowbreak{}toml} holds only what serving needs to load a model bundle and price a listing.
Everything else is in PEP 735 dependency groups (\texttt{pipeline}, \texttt{notebook}, \texttt{docs}, \texttt{test}, \texttt{dev}), and \texttt{default-\allowbreak{}groups =\allowbreak{} \textquotedbl{}all\textquotedbl{}} keeps a plain \texttt{uv sync} unchanged.
The API image will install the runtime alone.
\texttt{make test-\allowbreak{}serving}, a required CI check, fails when a serving module imports a package from a group.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Optional extras: \texttt{uv sync} leaves them out by default, so every documented command would change or quietly install less.
\item One flat list with \texttt{mlflow-\allowbreak{}skinny}: measured, it still pulls in most of what MLflow does.
\item A hand-written requirements file for the image: a second list that nothing ties to \texttt{uv.\allowbreak{}lock}.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} What matters is which dependencies reach the image at all.
Built from the lock, the runtime is 421 MB of site-packages against 815 MB for the full environment, and NFR-04 caps the image at 1 GB.
One lock and one resolution mean the image installs a subset of exactly what CI tested.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {Lukas chose groups over extras before the implementation.
AI traced the serving imports by running them, built both environments from the lock and showed that the check catches an injected training import.
An independent AI review found three ways the check could still be wrong; each is fixed and tested.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-10-05 on issue \#61 and on the review of PR \#69.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/61}{Issue \#61}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/69}{PR \#69}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/runtime_footprint_results.txt}{\texttt{runtime\_\allowbreak{}footprint\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, the Dependencies section of \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md}{CONTRIBUTING.md}.},
